gloss: ignoring what one hears; letting something pass without responding

definitions.gloss: ignoring what one hears; letting something pass without responding
definitions.explanation: The act of hearing something but choosing not to respond to it or act on it. Most commonly appears in the negative pattern 聞き捨てならない, meaning something one cannot ignore.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{発言|はつげん}→発言：05099_hatsugen⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{聞|き}き{捨|す}て⟦ならない→なる：01970_naru⟧。
{聞|き}き{捨|す}て⟦ならない→なる：01970_naru⟧こと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}われて→言う：00515_iu⟧、⟦{反論|はんろん}した→反論する：17280_hanronsuru⟧。
examples.english: I was told something I couldn't let pass, so I argued back.

examples.japanese: ⟦{友人|ゆうじん}→友人：03649_yuujin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{悪口|わるくち}→悪口：03794_warukuchi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{聞|き}き{捨|す}て⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦でき→できる：00557_dekiru⟧ず、「⟦それ→それ：00994_sore⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{違|ちが}う→違う：01957_chigau⟧」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{口|くち}を{挟|はさ}んだ→口を挟む：15229_kuchiwohasamu⟧。
examples.english: Unable to let the badmouthing of my friend pass, I interjected, "That's not true."

notes:
Compound of ⟦{聞|き}き→聞く：00483_kiku⟧ (hearing) + ⟦{捨|す}て→捨てる：00892_suteru⟧ (discarding). Almost always used in the negative.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {聞|き}き{捨|す}て⟦ならない→なる：01970_naru⟧ (cannot be ignored; something outrageous)
- {聞|き}き{捨|す}て⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦できない→できる：00557_dekiru⟧ (cannot let pass)
- {聞|き}き{捨|す}て⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to let pass without comment — rare, literary)

USAGE:
The phrase {聞|き}き{捨|す}て⟦ならない→なる：01970_naru⟧ expresses indignation — the speaker feels compelled to respond because what they heard was offensive, unfair, or outrageous. It is a moderately formal expression used in both speech and writing.
